questiontext.text: Who is a receptionist in a business organization?

generalfeedback.text: The receptionist is the frontline officer greeting visitors and managing telephone communication.

feedback.text: Incorrect. The receptionist is the frontline officer greeting visitors and managing telephone communication.

feedback.text: Correct! The receptionist is the frontline officer greeting visitors and managing telephone communication.

questiontext.text: Which of the following details are recorded in a standard Visitors' Book at the front desk? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Date, time, name, address, and purpose are standard entries. Bank passwords are never requested.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are essential attributes of an outstanding office receptionist? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Grooming, clear speech, tact, and confidentiality define excellence. Rudeness is unacceptable.
